run_stockstats_indicator: run the get_stock_stats method to retrieve a quantitative stock indicator value for a given ticker and date
load_ohlcv_data: load historical OHLCV stock data with caching and look-ahead bias filtering for a given symbol and date
filter_financials_by_date: filter financial statement columns to drop any fiscal periods that occur after a given cutoff date
retry_yfinance_calls: retry yfinance API calls with exponential backoff on rate limit errors up to three times
clean_stock_dataframe: clean and normalize a stock price DataFrame by parsing dates, coercing types, and filling missing values
